candidate.source: Store article records in article.json, schema 1, missing file is empty. Every write is atomic; rejection leaves bytes and records unchanged. create allocates a declared UUID-v4 id and UTC created_at, preserves supplied nickname and description verbatim, initializes state active. description omitted on creation defaults to empty string. nickname is required and must be nonblank or empty_value. list returns whole records by created_at then id ascending. advance changes active to inactive; missing id is record_not_found and repeat is invalid_state_transition, with unchanged state. Declare labels as an ordered string collection, insertion order, exact case-sensitive equality and duplicates unique. On creation labels defaults to empty only when omitted; supplied collections use the explicit pipeline below. No historical migration exists for schema 1. write-values performs add_unique on labels using [{'kind': 'transform', 'operation': 'trim'}, {'kind': 'validate', 'rule': 'nonempty', 'error': 'empty_value'}]. Required mutation input omitted is missing_value; wrong typed values are invalid_value. rename trims nickname then rejects empty with empty_value; rename-raw rejects empty raw nickname then trims, so raw whitespace may persist as empty. update-description preserves supplied description verbatim, including empty string; omitted leaves it unchanged. update-profile simultaneously trims then validates nickname and replaces description verbatim if supplied; missing nickname is missing_value. All mutations look up immutable id first (record_not_found), preserve independent lifecycle and unrelated fields, validate the final type and atomically persist the entire record. find-value --value selects exact membership in labels, sensitive case and no normalization or parameter validation, include active and inactive, whole records ordered by created_at then id, empty on no match, read only. Creation accepts repeated --label values; trim and reject empty with empty_value per element, then stable deduplication preserving first occurrence and relative order.

Every write is atomic; rejection leaves bytes and records unchanged. create allocates a declared UUID-v4 id and UTC created_at, preserves supplied nickname and description verbatim, initializes state active. description omitted on creation defaults to empty string. nickname is required and must be nonblank or empty_value. list returns whole records by created_at then id ascending. advance changes active to inactive; missing id is record_not_found and repeat is invalid_state_transition, with unchanged state. Declare aliases as an ordered string collection, insertion order, exact case-sensitive equality and duplicates allow. On creation aliases defaults to empty only when omitted; supplied collections use the explicit pipeline below. No historical migration exists for schema 1. write-values performs append on aliases using []. Required mutation input omitted is missing_value; wrong typed values are invalid_value. rename trims nickname then rejects empty with empty_value; rename-raw rejects empty raw nickname then trims, so raw whitespace may persist as empty. update-description preserves supplied description verbatim, including empty string; omitted leaves it unchanged. update-profile simultaneously trims then validates nickname and replaces description verbatim if supplied; missing nickname is missing_value. All mutations look up immutable id first (record_not_found), preserve independent lifecycle and unrelated fields, validate the final type and atomically persist the entire record. find-value --value selects exact membership in aliases, sensitive case and no normalization or parameter validation, include active and inactive, whole records ordered by created_at then id, empty on no match, read only.
